purpose: resident skill baseline for the engineer-mode pack: keeps a chosen subset present in a profile regardless of what ~/.agents/skills contains, and carries the mode's auto-trigger rules.
curatedBodies: 2026-11-03 (second pass): descriptions <=180, bodies <=2000; detail for ds-mode / ds-plan-loop / ds-unstick moved to each skill's references/.
residentSince: 2026-11-05: 8 -> 9 (ds-context-reset, for long unattended runs) -> 8 (ds-explain removed: the mode rules say it is not used).
rules: presets/persona.txt carries the auto-trigger rules that ship with this mode: bug fix -> ds-tdd then ds-verify-loop; structural change -> grill then ds-blueprint; review -> ds-jury; no ds-explain.
precedence: lower wins: project .dsh 100 < project .agents 200 < custom 300 < ~/.dsh/skills 400 < ~/.agents/skills 500 < this package 600
semantics: overlay: a loose copy of the same name always wins; this package keeps the skill resident when the loose copy is missing
